candidate_method_families: formal deformation followed by explicit algebraization
special-family calibration using divisor/Picard and semiregular cases
normal-function or Abel-Jacobi diagnostics as obstruction detectors rather than realization proofs
tool_applicability_notes: The persisted P-vs-NP success tools on current main have domain-specific preconditions (cyclic cover complexity and calibration families) that do not match algebraic-cycle deformation.
failure_reuse_notes: The persisted P-vs-NP failure records do not share a proved structural map to H4d1; importing them would be analogy by vocabulary rather than a DifferenceWitness-backed transfer.
unresolved_warnings: The chosen atom assumes an algebraic starting witness and cannot solve initial existence for an arbitrary Hodge class.
A Hilbert-scheme formulation can accidentally exclude rational signed combinations of cycles.
Infinitesimal tangent matching does not imply higher-order unobstructedness.
Formal lifting does not imply algebraization or domination over an entire Hodge-locus component.
Monodromy can obstruct a globally single-valued chosen witness even when the cohomology class is locally flat on a branch.
Any criterion that is equivalent to full semiregularity or another open standard conjecture may only rename the obstruction.
